objective: Preserve three obsolete owned build trees on NVMe and measure whether removing their tmpfs charge materially raises host MemAvailable for a future E18 bridge admission.
preservation: rsync -aH copy, rsync -aHcn --delete byte comparison, replace original directory with symlink to verified archive; original paths remain usable. Source and current C75/C84 builds are untouched.
preconditions: No running process from the selected builds
Selected source directories are real directories
NVMe free space exceeds source size plus 20 GiB
measurement: Read MemAvailable and Shmem immediately before and after relocation; this alone is not 60-second capacity admission.
failure_policy: Stop on any copy or checksum mismatch, keep source; preserve partial archive for inspection. Do not delete raw results or services.
